title: Sensors emit status='unknown' rather than throw when required inputs are absent
statement: Every sensor MUST emit a SensorReading with `status: 'unknown'` and an explanatory finding when a required input (config file, sibling sensor body, external CLI binary, network endpoint) is absent or unreachable. Sensors MUST NOT throw ENOENT or equivalent errors to the caller.
rationale: Phase 26.K (`harness_green_main`) established graceful-degradation as the load-bearing contract for sensors that depend on external preconditions. Phase 29.B + Phase 30 lane D enforced this for `sense-spec-idiomaticity` and `sense-inventory-adherence` after they crashed in adopter / self-application runs. A throwing sensor breaks the autonomous-loop assumption that 'any sensor can run; verdict is what we read.' Status='unknown' preserves the contract.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
